title: angular-typechecker configuration generator
description: Wire a typecheck target (executor angular-typechecker:typecheck) into a project's project.json.

project.description: The project to add a typecheck target to.

tsConfig.description: Explicit tsconfig path, interpreted project-root-relative (or absolute), overriding solution/flat resolution. The generator resolves it and writes a WORKSPACE-root-relative path into the target's options.tsConfig (the base the executor uses); an absolute path is written verbatim and is machine-specific -- prefer a project-root-relative path for portability across machines and CI.
